tagline: From a conversation to an auditable conclusion.
settingsHint: Language preferences and API credentials stay on this machine.
tokenHint: Use your own TypeSafe API key. It is sent only to TypeSafe for verification and judgments, then saved locally with 0600 permissions. It is never returned to the page.
environmentToken: An environment token is active and takes precedence over the file saved here.
pasteId: Paste a link or enter an ID
subject: Subject
subjectHint: Optional; uses the source title by default
question: Question
questionPlaceholder: What do you want to know about this content?
levels: Levels (one per line, low to high)
runHint: Jev judges; code counts. Filtering never calls the model again.
emptyText: Fetch a conversation and choose a question. Trace every percentage back to the original words.
author: Author
authorNote: Authors are grouped by their main verdict. Filters below still show comments with that verdict.
distributionHint: Select a category to inspect the original comments.
noAnswer: No passage directly answers this question
noAnswerHint: Try a classification or yes / no question.
limitError: Use a whole number between 1 and 2000
optionsError: Provide at least two distinct options; scores allow up to 10 levels.
sourceChanged: Source changed. Fetch its content before analyzing.
originalLanguage: Comments, edited questions and existing judgments keep their original language.

favor.name: Like / dislike
favor.question: What is this comment’s attitude toward {{subject}}: like, neutral, dislike, or unrelated?

mood.name: Sentiment
mood.question: Is this comment positive, negative, neutral or factual, or unrelated?

rate.name: Satisfaction
rate.question: According to this comment, how satisfied is the author with {{subject}}?

onTopic.name: Topic relevance
onTopic.question: Is this comment about {{subject}}, does it only mention it, or is it unrelated?

junk.name: Content quality
junk.question: Is this comment substantive, noise, or likely spam or advertising?

genericSubject: the topic of the video or post
